ports.tagline: Fallout 2 CE rebuilt for touch screens in landscape, with a bottom-screen companion for dual-screen handhelds. Early beta.
Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius (2001), rebuilt as a C++ reconstruction that runs natively on the AYN Thor. In progress.
Jimmy Neutron vs. Jimmy Negatron (2002), rebuilt natively for the Thor, with widescreen and a second-screen panel.
Rollerbot: A Time Journey (2000), a fan reconstruction for the AYN Thor and Linux (Flatpak). About 55% done.
SpongeBob SquarePants: Employee of the Month (2002), a preservation port for the AYN Thor. About 82% done.
